title: Agricultural and food-system impact types
description: Directional and operational impacts through which contextual events affect agriculture, food, markets and ecosystems.

terms.label: Production impact
terms.definition: A grouping family for material effects on agricultural production volume, capacity or performance.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only to organize specific production impacts; assign a child term supported by the evidence.

terms.label: Production increase
terms.definition: A material increase in actual or expected agricultural production.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include higher output or capacity; exclude yield improvement without evidence of aggregate production increase.

terms.label: Production decrease
terms.definition: A material reduction in actual or expected agricultural production.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include lower output or capacity; exclude isolated crop damage without a supported production effect.

terms.label: Yield increase
terms.definition: A material increase in output per unit of land, animal or production input.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include productivity gains; distinguish from total production changes caused only by expanded area or herd size.

terms.label: Yield decrease
terms.definition: A material reduction in output per unit of land, animal or production input.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include productivity losses; distinguish from total production changes caused only by reduced area or herd size.

terms.label: Crop damage
terms.definition: Physical or biological damage to standing or harvested crops.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include documented crop injury or loss; exclude forecast risk without observed or expected crop damage.

terms.label: Livestock loss
terms.definition: Mortality, culling or material loss of productive livestock assets.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include documented loss of farmed animals; exclude temporary productivity decline without animal loss.

terms.label: Supply impact
terms.definition: A grouping family for material effects on market availability or delivery of goods.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only to organize specific supply impacts; assign a child term supported by the evidence.

terms.label: Supply increase
terms.definition: A material increase in goods available to a market or supply chain.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include increased market availability; exclude production increases not yet connected to supply.

terms.label: Supply decrease
terms.definition: A material reduction in goods available to a market or supply chain.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include lower market availability; exclude production decline without supported supply consequences.

terms.label: Supply disruption
terms.definition: An interruption or instability in normal supply-chain availability or delivery.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include delayed, blocked or unreliable supply; use SUPPLY_DECREASE when only the resulting volume reduction is known.

terms.label: Demand impact
terms.definition: A grouping family for material effects on willingness or ability to purchase goods or services.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only to organize specific demand impacts; assign a child term supported by the evidence.

terms.label: Demand increase
terms.definition: A material increase in demand for an agricultural good, food product, input or service.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include observed or credibly expected higher demand; exclude price increases without demand evidence.

terms.label: Demand decrease
terms.definition: A material reduction in demand for an agricultural good, food product, input or service.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include observed or credibly expected lower demand; exclude supply-driven sales decline without demand evidence.

terms.label: Price impact
terms.definition: A grouping family for material effects on prices or price stability.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only to organize specific price impacts; assign a child term supported by the evidence.

terms.label: Price increase
terms.definition: A material increase in the price of an agricultural good, food product, input or service.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include supported upward price movement; exclude cost increases not passed into price.

terms.label: Price decrease
terms.definition: A material decrease in the price of an agricultural good, food product, input or service.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include supported downward price movement; exclude lower costs without price evidence.

terms.label: Price volatility
terms.definition: A material increase in the magnitude or unpredictability of price movements.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include instability rather than one directional move; exclude ordinary seasonal price variation unless unusually pronounced.

terms.label: Cost impact
terms.definition: A grouping family for material effects on costs incurred by agricultural or food-system actors.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only to organize specific cost impacts; assign a child term supported by the evidence.

terms.label: Input-cost increase
terms.definition: A material increase in the cost of agricultural production inputs.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include seeds, fertilizer, feed, crop protection and machinery costs; exclude energy or transport costs when those can be classified specifically.

terms.label: Input-cost decrease
terms.definition: A material reduction in the cost of agricultural production inputs.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include lower costs for production inputs; exclude output-price decreases.

terms.label: Transport-cost increase
terms.definition: A material increase in costs of moving agricultural or food goods.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include freight and distribution cost increases; exclude delays without a supported cost effect.

terms.label: Energy-cost increase
terms.definition: A material increase in energy costs borne by agricultural or food-system actors.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include fuel, electricity and heating cost effects; exclude general energy-price news without a documented sector cost implication.

terms.label: Trade impact
terms.definition: A grouping family for material effects on access to or movement through agricultural and food trade channels.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only to organize specific trade impacts; assign a child term supported by the evidence.

terms.label: Trade-restriction impact
terms.definition: Reduced trade access caused by a tariff, quota, ban, sanction or comparable barrier.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include the agricultural consequence of a restriction; use the general event type for the restriction itself.

terms.label: Trade-facilitation impact
terms.definition: Improved trade access or efficiency caused by reduced barriers or improved procedures.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include agricultural benefits of easier trade; exclude general agreements without an identified facilitation effect.

terms.label: Export disruption
terms.definition: A material interruption or constraint affecting outbound agricultural or food trade.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include blocked or reduced exports; exclude export-price changes without flow disruption.

terms.label: Import-dependency increase
terms.definition: A material increase in reliance on imported agricultural or food supply.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include structural or documented higher import reliance; exclude a one-time import purchase.

terms.label: Food-security impact
terms.definition: A grouping family for material effects on food availability, access, utilization or stability.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only to organize specific food-security impacts; assign a directional child term supported by the evidence.

terms.label: Food-security improvement
terms.definition: A material improvement in one or more dimensions of food security.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include improved availability, access, utilization or stability; exclude production gains without a supported food-security effect.

terms.label: Food-security deterioration
terms.definition: A material worsening in one or more dimensions of food security.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include worsening availability, access, utilization or stability; exclude price changes without a supported food-security consequence.

terms.label: Environmental impact
terms.definition: A grouping family for material agricultural or food-system effects on ecosystems, resources or environmental quality.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use only to organize specific environmental impacts; assign a directional child term supported by the evidence.

terms.label: Positive environmental impact
terms.definition: A material improvement in environmental condition or resource stewardship attributable to agricultural activity or change.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include demonstrated environmental benefit; exclude claims of benefit without evidence of an environmental effect.

terms.label: Negative environmental impact
terms.definition: A material degradation of environmental condition or resources attributable to agricultural activity or change.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include demonstrated environmental harm; exclude general production loss without environmental damage.
